defaultPrompt: Use RPFM to inspect this Total War packfile and explain its contents.
Use RPFM to find a table, localization entry, or reference in my mod.
Use RPFM to make a focused edit and save a separate mod pack.
interface.longDescription: Work with Total War packfiles through local RPFM Server. Includes Windows/Linux server installation, MCP registration, game/schema/dependency setup, DB and localization editing, diagnostics, Lua tests, MyMod, release optimization, specialized asset guidance, session recovery, and a 50-page manual coverage map with a 155-tool schema snapshot. Requires a compatible local RPFM Server.

name: rpfm
description: RPFM server setup and extensive Total War mod workflows, with manual coverage and live MCP reference.
